newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Singamas names executive vice chair as CEO.
newsitem.headline: Singamas names executive vice chair as CEO.

text.p: Container manufacturer and container depot operator Singamas Container Holdings Ltd said on Monday Siong Sent Teo, executive vice-chairman, would replace David Wong as chief executive officer, effective February 1.
Wong, who wanted to pursue other interests, would remain as non-executive director of the company, it said in a statement.
Singama also said that Simon Lu would relinquish his role as executive director and would remain as non-executive director of the company with effect from February 1.
